content_of_post_to_comment: World War II wasn’t the focal point of high school history because of meddling from “duh joos” or liberals. It’s because a ton of history teachers were also probably dad’s and football coaches who thought WWII was awesome and that’s what they wanted to teach.
comment: There’s also a feedback loop here: the stories teachers find compelling shape what students remember as “important” history, which then shapes future teachers’ instincts.
